name: Vadhu Ramblings
body:
Vadhu is a campaign world of my imagining that takes place in a world ravaged by the Demonic, the Undead and their Reptilian allies (kobolds, lizardmen, troglodytes, and so on) for the past 500 years. The world has been cut off from the outer planes by the loathesome creature who led his army here: Orcus.

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
